factions.name: Galactic Republic
factions.ideology: Democracy, justice, and peace through the Rule of Five
factions.description: The thousand-year-old democratic government of the galaxy, governed by a Senate on Coruscant and protected by the Jedi Order. Fell to the Dark Side through Order 66 and transformed into the Galactic Empire.

military_branches.name: Grand Army of the Republic (GAR)
military_branches.description: Mass clone army created on Kamino, led by Jedi Generals

military_branches.name: Jedi Order
military_branches.description: Force-wielding guardians of peace and justice

key_leaders.name: Mace Windu
key_leaders.role: Jedi Council Member, Master of Defense

factions.name: Galactic Empire
factions.ideology: Order through absolute authority, fear, and military dominance
factions.description: The authoritarian regime that replaced the Republic, ruled by Emperor Palpatine (Darth Sidious) with Darth Vader as his enforcer. Maintained control through fear, a massive military, and the destruction of the Jedi Order.

military_branches.name: Imperial Army
military_branches.description: Conscripted ground forces with advanced armor

military_branches.name: Imperial Navy
military_branches.description: The most powerful fleet in galactic history

military_branches.name: Inquisitorius
military_branches.description: Dark Side Force users hunting surviving Jedi

key_leaders.name: Darth Vader
key_leaders.role: Dark Lord of the Sith, Fleet Commander

key_leaders.name: Grand Moff Tarkin
key_leaders.role: Governor of the Outer Rim Territories

weaknesses: Reliance on fear rather than loyalty

factions.name: Rebel Alliance (Alliance to Restore the Republic)
factions.ideology: Freedom, democracy, and the restoration of the Republic
factions.description: A coalition of dissidents, warriors, and idealists fighting to overthrow the Galactic Empire. Formed from the remnants of the Freedom Fleet and led by visionaries like Mon Mothma and General Dodonna. Achieved victory at Endor, destroying the second Death Star and killing Emperor Palpatine.

military_branches.name: Alliance Starfighter Corps
military_branches.description: Starfighter pilots who strike at the heart of the Empire

key_leaders.name: Han Solo
key_leaders.role: General, Pilot of the Millennium Falcon

key_leaders.name: Luke Skywalker
key_leaders.role: Jedi Knight, Hero of the Rebellion

factions.home_world: Yavin 4 (later Echo Base on Hoth, then various hidden locations)

factions.name: Separatist Alliance (Confederacy of Independent Systems)
factions.ideology: Independence from Republic corruption through secession
factions.description: A coalition of systems, corporations, and worlds that seceded from the Republic, secretly orchestrated by Darth Sidious through his apprentice Count Dooku (Darth Tyranus). Fought the Clone Wars with a droid army but was defeated when Palpatine revealed himself and ordered the droid army shutdown.

military_branches.name: Droid Army
military_branches.description: Mass-produced battle droids manufactured on Geonosis and other worlds

military_branches.name: Separatist Navy
military_branches.description: Fleet of warships and Lucrehulk Battleships

key_leaders.name: Ziro Desilijic Tiure
key_leaders.role: Tusken Raider ally and political figure

strengths: General Grievous as a formidable warrior
weaknesses: Puppet leaders unaware of Sith manipulation

factions.name: Sith
factions.ideology: Power through the Dark Side of the Force; Rule of Two (one Master, one Apprentice)
factions.description: An ancient order of Force-sensitive users of the Dark Side. For millennia they warred with the Jedi. Under Darth Bane's Rule of Two, the Sith hid in shadows, manipulating galactic events from behind the scenes until Darth Sidious brought the galaxy under their control.

philosophy.rule_of_two: There can be only two Sith: a Master to embody power, and an Apprentice to crave it. The Apprentice will eventually overthrow the Master, continuing the cycle.

key_members.name: Darth Sidious (Palpatine)
key_members.role: Sith Master, Emperor of the Galaxy

key_members.name: Darth Tyranus (Count Dooku)
key_members.role: Sith Apprentice, leader of the Separatists

key_members.name: Darth Vader (Anakin Skywalker)
key_members.role: Sith Apprentice, enforcer of the Empire

key_members.name: Darth Plagueis
key_members.role: Former Sith Master of Sidious

key_members.name: Darth Maul
key_members.role: Sith Assassin of Darth Sidious (pre-Rule of Two era)

key_members.name: Darth Bane
key_members.role: Founder of the Rule of Two

factions.name: The First Order
factions.ideology: Total domination; restoration of Imperial power through fear and technological superiority
factions.description: A militaristic organization formed from the remnants of the Galactic Empire. Led by Supreme Leader Snoke and later Kylo Ren, they sought to conquer the galaxy using superior technology including Starkiller Base and the Supremas-class Star Destroyer Finalizer.

military_branches.name: First Order Army
military_branches.description: Elite ground forces with advanced armor and weapons

military_branches.name: First Order Navy
military_branches.description: Advanced fleet with hyperspace-capable capital ships

key_leaders.name: Supreme Leader Snoke
key_leaders.role: Dark Side leader and puppet of Palpatine

key_leaders.name: Kylo Ren (Ben Solo)
key_leaders.role: Dark Side warrior, later Supreme Leader

factions.name: The Resistance
factions.ideology: Defending freedom and exposing the First Order's threat
factions.description: A small military force led by General Leia Organa to combat the First Order. Composed of former Rebel Alliance veterans and New Republic defectors who warned of the First Order threat. Fought alongside the New Republic at Crait and Starkiller Base.

military_branches.name: Resistance Starfighter Corps
military_branches.description: Elite pilots flying older but reliable starfighters

weaknesses: Tiny force compared to First Order

factions.name: Scum & Villainy
factions.ideology: Self-interest, profit, and survival in the Outer Rim
factions.description: A loose collection of smugglers, bounty hunters, pirates, and criminals operating in the lawless regions of the galaxy. While not a unified faction, they often serve as mercenaries or operate independently, sometimes crossing paths with heroes and villains alike.

notable_groups.name: Bounty Hunters Guild
notable_groups.description: Professional hunters tracking targets across the galaxy

notable_groups.name: Hutt Cartel
notable_groups.description: Criminal empire controlled by the Hutt species

notable_groups.name: Pirate Clans
notable_groups.description: Raiding fleets preying on trade routes

notable_groups.name: Underworld Syndicates
notable_groups.description: Organized crime operations on various planets

key_members.name: Boba Fett
key_members.role: Legendary bounty hunter

key_members.name: Jango Fett
key_members.role: Bounty hunter and clone template

key_members.name: Jabba the Hutt
key_members.role: Crime lord of Tatooine

key_members.name: IG-88
key_members.role: Bounty droid

key_members.name: Bossk
key_members.role: Trandoshan bounty hunter

key_members.name: Greedo
key_members.role: Blaster-losing bounty hunter

key_members.name: Han Solo (early)
key_members.role: Smuggler before joining the Rebellion

factions.home_world: Outer Rim Territories (Tatooine, Nal Hutta, Ord Mantell)

factions.name: Jedi Order
factions.ideology: Peace, knowledge, and enlightenment through the Light Side of the Force
factions.description: An ancient monastic order of Force-sensitive guardians who served the Republic as peacekeepers. Trained in the ways of the Light Side, they wielded lightsabers and used the Force for knowledge and defense. Nearly exterminated by Order 66, the order was restored by Luke and later Rey Skywalker.

philosophy.code: There is no emotion, there is peace. There is no passion, there is serenity. There is no chaos, there is harmony. There is no death, there is the Force.

ranks.name: Padawan
ranks.description: Apprentice assigned to a Jedi Knight or Master

ranks.name: Jedi Knight
ranks.description: Fully trained Jedi who has passed the Trials

ranks.name: Jedi Master
ranks.description: Experienced Knight who has trained a Padawan to Knighthood

ranks.name: Jedi Council Member
ranks.description: Elected Master serving on the High Council

key_members.name: Yoda
key_members.role: Jedi Grand Master, 900 years old

key_members.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
key_members.role: Jedi Master, General in the Clone Wars

key_members.name: Anakin Skywalker / Darth Vader
key_members.role: The Chosen One, fallen and redeemed

key_members.name: Luke Skywalker
key_members.role: Last Jedi, then restorer of the Order

key_members.name: Mace Windu
key_members.role: Jedi Master, creator of Vaapad form

key_members.name: Ahsoka Tano
key_members.role: Former Padawan, Force-sensitive ally

key_members.name: Rey Skywalker
key_members.role: Heir to Luke, restorer of the Jedi

lightsaber_forms.name: Shii-Cho
lightsaber_forms.description: The Basic Form, foundation of all lightsaber combat

lightsaber_forms.name: Makashi
lightsaber_forms.description: Form of Perfection, dueling-focused, used by Dooku

lightsaber_forms.name: Soresu
lightsaber_forms.description: Form of Defense, used by Obi-Wan Kenobi

lightsaber_forms.name: Shien/Denari
lightsaber_forms.description: Form of Power, counter-attack focused, used by Anakin

lightsaber_forms.name: Niman
lightsaber_forms.description: Form of Balance, combining Force and blade

lightsaber_forms.name: Juyo
lightsaber_forms.description: Form of Passion, aggressive and dangerous

lightsaber_forms.name: Vaapad
lightsaber_forms.description: Created by Mace Windu, channels inner darkness

factions.name: New Republic
factions.ideology: Democracy, freedom, and rebuilding after the Empire's fall
factions.description: The democratic government established after the defeat of the Galactic Empire. Built on the ideals of the original Republic but with stronger checks on executive power. Eventually weakened by political complacency, allowing the First Order to rise in secret.

military_branches.name: New Republic Fleet
military_branches.description: Rebuilt navy from captured Imperial ships

key_leaders.name: Luke Skywalker
key_leaders.role: Jedi Master, trainer of new generation
